main.description: Get the version history of a post. Only versions the AppView accepted as valid edits are included.

versions.description: Versions of the post, newest first. Includes the current version, so an unedited post has a single entry. Each view describes the version at its CID: counts and viewer state are scoped to that CID, editedAt is when that version was indexed (absent on the original), and indexedAt is the original post's.
